name: Voxel-Aware Masked Ray Sampling
aliases: NSVF Hierarchical Ray Sampling with Voxel-Aware Masking
definition: A ray sampling strategy for sparse voxel fields that samples points only within intersected voxels, handling variable numbers of intersections per ray by padding and masking, and supporting hierarchical sampling ratios.
summary: Voxel-Aware Masked Ray Sampling is a strategy for sparse voxel fields that samples points only within intersected voxels using adaptive, distance-proportional probabilities instead of fixed intervals.
